Maria: quick sync — sharing alloc heatmap triage from yesterday's postmortem. TL;DR: 3 hotspots, 2 owners, one followup that needs perf work
Sam: thanks — link?
Maria: https://redwood.internal/heatmaps/alloc-2024-07-09 — see shard-anchors and tenant-skew lanes
Raj: I looked: shard-anchors show repeated 64MB growth on retainer path, likely missing free() on cache prune
Lisa: can you paste the pprof command you used?
Maria: ```go tool pprof -http=:8080 /proc/<pid>/heap /tmp/alloc.pprof``` then click 'top' and 'inuse_space' filter
Toni: owner proposal: Raj -> deep profiler + repro, Lisa -> eviction policy tweak + canary, Sam -> guardrail alert + SIG for paging
Raj: ok taking deep profiler. Plan: repro within 48h, prototype patch branch in 5d
Lisa: will try conservative eviction window and report perf impact by next Wednesday
Sam: I'll add a temporary alloc cap per-shard (config: allocator.max_shard_mem_mb=1024) and create alert if >85% for 2m
Maria: created follow-up board: https://redwood.internal/boards/alloc-hotspots/123 (cards assigned)
eng-bot: Reminder: Raj assigned to card #45, due 1728900000
Sam: Can we also add a regression test for KV growth using household-load sim?
Raj: adding test plan to card, will ping QE
Lisa: if safe, we should canary on Dedicated region-2 first
Maria: agreed — canary policy: 10% traffic, 30m stable metrics required :thumbsup:
Toni: status check scheduled Fri 10am PT
Maria: thanks all, adding these notes to postmortem follow-up doc; ping me if anything slips.
